key_concepts: Materials have chemical properties that determine their uses
Flammability describes how easily a material catches fire
Combustibility describes a material's ability to burn
Some materials react with other materials
Corrosion is a reaction of materials with their environment
Rust forms when iron reacts with water and oxygen
Materials can be protected from corrosion
Non-biodegradable materials do not decompose easily
Biodegradable materials are often made from plant fibers or starches
Using biodegradable materials reduces environmental harm
